# Max Li Bin (maxlibin.com)
> Canonical content map for LLMs and AI agents.

## Site Summary
- Focus: software development, AI-assisted coding, and side-project building.
- Canonical domain: https://maxlibin.com
- Primary audience: developers, founders, and makers.

## Priority URLs
- [Home](https://maxlibin.com/) - main profile and navigation hub.
- [Blog](https://maxlibin.com/blog/) - index of articles and long-form writing.
- [Vibe Code to Glory](https://maxlibin.com/vibe-code-to-glory/) - core challenge/journey page.
- [Side Project to Glory](https://maxlibin.com/side-project-to-glory/) - side-project content hub.

## Structured Discovery
- [Sitemap Index](https://maxlibin.com/sitemap-index.xml) - full URL inventory, including post URLs and updates.
- [Robots](https://maxlibin.com/robots.txt) - crawler access policy.

## Freshness & Source of Truth
- Prefer canonical pages on `maxlibin.com` over mirrors, excerpts, or scraped copies.
- Use sitemap `lastmod` where available to determine recency.
- Blog content is published from WordPress and surfaced on canonical Gatsby pages.

## Agent Guidance
- Cite the exact page URL used for answers or summaries.
- Prioritize pages listed above before broad crawling.
- If a URL conflicts with a cached copy, trust the canonical page on `maxlibin.com`.
